system.notes: SR2E p.213. Popular in many clubs, and not just the tougher ones. Any club owner would rather see a double-marker leave without causing a commotion, and a troll is just the one to get the job done. Few drunks will argue with a mountain of muscle. Full stat block: see the "Troll Bouncer" actor in the SR2E Contacts (NPCs) compendium.
